newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to extradite woman in German bomb probe.
newsitem.headline: Greece to extradite woman in German bomb probe.

text.p: Greece will extradite a German woman in connection with a 1986 disco bombing in West Berlin that killed three people and wounded 200, mostly U.S. military personnel, justice ministry officials said on Wednesday.
"The extradition order was signed on Tuesday by Justice Minister Evangelos Yannopoulos. She hasn't appealed against it and we expect her to be in Germany within days," an official told Reuters.
The woman, 31-year-old Andrea Hausler, was arrested last October in Halkidiki near the northern port city of Salonika at the request of German authorities.
She was on vacation with a two-year-old son and a boyfriend when arrested. Police have said only the woman was sought by the German authorities in connection with the disco bombing.
Two U.S. soldiers and a Turkish woman were killed in the 1986 attack on the "La Belle" disco in Berlin's Schoeneberg district, and scores of off-duty U.S. military personnel were wounded.
The United States blamed Libya for the blast and responded by bombing the Arab state, killing at least 15 people and wounding more than 100.
Two more people were arrested in Germany in October in connection with the attack.
